objectives: Explain what it means to walk before the Most High and be perfect.
Describe the covenant, its seed, and its token of circumcision.
Explain why the covenant was established with Isaac and not Ishmael.
takeaways: Perfect means to walk in His statutes and keep His commandments (1 Kings 8:61); there is no age excuse.
Abram became Abraham, father of many nations; the same promise passed to Jacob and was divided among the twelve tribes.
The covenant is with Abraham's literal seed; Israel is the seed of Abraham (Isaiah 41:8).
Circumcision is the token of the covenant; it sealed the faith Abraham already had, and it still has to be done (Romans 4:11).
In Isaac shall thy seed be called: the children of the promise are counted for the seed (Romans 9:7-9). Abraham obeyed the selfsame day.
